tools.name: ab_test_significance
tools.title: A/B test significance
tools.description: Two-proportion test of an A/B result: conversion rates, relative uplift, p-value, confidence interval, the chance that B beats A, and a sample ratio mismatch check. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/ab-test-calculator

tools.name: calculate_arr
tools.title: Calculate ARR from MRR
tools.description: Turn monthly recurring revenue into annual recurring revenue (ARR = MRR x 12), with ARPU when the customer count is given and the months to $100k, $1M and $10M ARR at a monthly growth rate. Count annual plans at their yearly price divided by 12 and leave one-time fees out of MRR. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/arr-calculator

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in any currency

monthly_growth_pct.description: Expected MRR growth per month in percent, e.g. 8 (optional)

tools.name: calculate_arr_bridge
tools.title: ARR bridge: new, expansion, contraction, churn
tools.description: Explain how ARR moved over a period: ending ARR = starting ARR + new + expansion - contraction - churned. Returns net new ARR, growth, the SaaS quick ratio ((new + expansion) / (contraction + churned)), and net and gross revenue retention of the starting base. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/arr-calculator

start_arr.description: ARR at the start of the period

new_arr.description: ARR from customers who started paying in the period

expansion_arr.description: ARR added by existing customers (upgrades, seats, add-ons)

contraction_arr.description: ARR lost to downgrades from customers who stayed

churned_arr.description: ARR lost to customers who cancelled

tools.name: calculate_churn
tools.title: Customer churn rate
tools.description: Customer churn and retention for a period, its monthly and annual equivalents (compounded, so 5% a month is about 46% a year, not 60%), and the average customer lifetime. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/churn-rate-calculator

customers_at_start.description: Customers at the start of the period

customers_lost.description: Customers from that base who cancelled during the period

tools.name: calculate_nps
tools.title: Net Promoter Score
tools.description: Net Promoter Score from the counts of promoters (9-10), passives (7-8) and detractors (0-6), with the margin of error at 95% confidence. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/nps-calculator

tools.name: calculate_nrr
tools.title: Net and gross revenue retention
tools.description: Net revenue retention (NRR) and gross revenue retention (GRR) of a group of customers from their starting MRR, expansion, contraction and churned MRR, with annualised figures. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/net-revenue-retention-calculator

start_mrr.description: MRR of the customers at the start of the period

tools.name: check_backlink
tools.title: Check a directory backlink
tools.description: Check whether a directory listing page links to your site and whether that link is followed. Reads the page's static HTML and reports every anchor pointing at your domain with its rel (nofollow, ugc, sponsored), hidden links, links that only go through the directory's own redirect, and page-level noindex, nofollow and canonical. Use it after submitting to directories to see which listings went live and which ones pass a dofollow link.

page_url.description: The directory page that lists your product, e.g. "https://somedirectory.com/tools/your-product"

your_domain.description: Your product's domain or any URL on it, e.g. "example.com". Subdomains count as matches.

tools.name: check_badge
tools.title: Check the SaaSCity badge
tools.description: Check whether the SaaSCity badge is live on a site. Reads the given URL and, for a deep page, the site homepage too, rendering JavaScript if needed. Free listings require a badge and use nofollow website links.

url.description: Site URL to scan (the listing URL; the homepage is read as well)

tools.name: check_launch_readiness
tools.title: Check launch readiness
tools.description: Audit a product homepage before launching it: HTTPS, noindex, title and meta description, og:image (fetched to confirm it loads), X card, favicon, canonical, mobile viewport, h1, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap, parked or 404 pages, response time, and whether the page is empty without JavaScript. Returns a 0-100 score, a verdict and a fix for every problem. Reads the static HTML the way directory scrapers and link-preview bots do.

url.description: Homepage URL; the https:// prefix is optional

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.title: Find alternatives to a listing
tools.description: Other SaaSCity listings in the same category as a given listing, most upvoted first. Useful for competitor research and positioning.

slug.description: Slug of the listing to find alternatives for

tools.name: find_launch_directories
tools.title: Find launch directories
tools.description: Filter 1,667 startup, SaaS and AI directories by category, minimum Ahrefs DR, link type (dofollow/nofollow), price and badge-swap requirement. Returns submit URLs. Link type and price are "unknown" where nobody has verified them yet - treat those as unverified, not as free or dofollow.

query.description: Match against directory name or domain, e.g. "hunt" or "betalist"

pricing.description: free_or_freemium = there is a no-cost route

exclude_badge_exchange.description: Drop directories whose free listing requires their badge on your site

tools.name: get_launch_directory
tools.title: Look up a launch directory
tools.description: Look up one directory by domain or URL: Ahrefs DR, dofollow or nofollow, price, whether it wants a badge swap, the submit URL, and a human verdict where one exists. Use it to vet a directory before paying for a listing.

domain.description: Directory domain or any URL on it, e.g. "uneed.best" or "https://www.producthunt.com/posts/new"

tools.name: get_launch_weeks
tools.title: Get launch weeks
tools.description: SaaSCity launch weeks: the next 12 Mondays. A round opens each Monday at 00:00 UTC, and a paid listing can take any of them.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get the launch leaderboard
tools.description: SaaSCity's most upvoted launches for this week's launch, the last 30 days, or all time, optionally within one category.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: Get a SaaSCity listing
tools.description: One live SaaSCity listing by slug: title, tagline, full description, category, upvote points, link type (dofollow/nofollow), listing page and product site.

slug.description: Listing slug, the last part of saascity.io/live/<slug>

tools.name: get_offers
tools.title: Get listing offers
tools.description: SaaSCity paid listing offers and the free badge option. Only a human can pay, on the claim page.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.title: Get submission status
tools.description: Where a SaaSCity submission stands. By claim token: unclaimed, expired, claimed but the form not submitted yet, submitted and waiting for payment, submitted and in review, rejected, archived, or live. By slug: a live listing (launch week, badge, link type, points).

claim_token.description: Token from submit_project (the mcp_... part of the claim URL)

tools.name: markup_margin
tools.title: Markup and margin
tools.description: Selling price, profit and margin from a cost and a markup percent, or markup and margin from a cost and a selling price. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/markup-calculator

markup_pct.description: Markup in percent (give this or price)

tools.name: recommend_launch_directories
tools.title: Recommend launch directories
tools.description: Hand-picked launch directories for a product type, grouped by when to submit (launch day first, evergreen after). Every pick carries a human-written verdict, including the ones that are not worth paying for, plus Ahrefs DR, link type and price. Start here; use find_launch_directories to go wider across all 1,667 sites.

product_type.description: saas = B2B/B2C software, ai = AI tool or app, devtools = sold to developers, any = general

free_only.description: Only picks with a free or freemium route

tools.name: rule_of_40
tools.title: Rule of 40 and SaaS efficiency
tools.description: Rule of 40 score (revenue growth % + profit margin %), plus the magic number, burn multiple and SaaS quick ratio when their inputs are given. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/rule-of-40-calculator

margin_pct.description: Profit margin in percent (EBITDA or free cash flow); negative when losing money

revenue_this_quarter.description: Optional: revenue this quarter, for the magic number

sales_marketing_last_quarter.description: Optional: sales and marketing spend last quarter

net_burn.description: Optional: net burn over a period, for the burn multiple

net_new_arr.description: Optional: net new ARR over the same period

new_mrr.description: Optional: new MRR, for the quick ratio

tools.name: search_listings
tools.title: Search SaaSCity listings
tools.description: Search products listed on SaaSCity by keyword and/or category. Returns title, tagline, category, upvote points, the listing page and the product site. Useful for market research ("what else exists in this space?") before a launch.

query.description: Keyword matched against title and tagline

tools.name: submit_project
tools.title: Submit a project to SaaSCity
tools.description: List a product on the SaaSCity launch directory. Creates a draft and returns a claim URL. The human signs in, chooses a paid plan or an available free badge slot, and submits the prefilled form for review. Only the human pays for a paid plan. Free subdomain hosts and domains that already have a listing are refused.

tagline.description: One line on what it does and for whom

description.description: Plain text: the problem, who it is for, what makes it different

website_url.description: Product homepage, https, on its own domain

tools.name: uptime_downtime
tools.title: SLA uptime to allowed downtime
tools.description: Allowed downtime per day, week, month, quarter and year, in seconds, for an availability target such as 99.9%. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/uptime-calculator

prompts.name: plan_launch
prompts.title: Plan a product launch
prompts.description: Audit a site, fix what blocks launch, pick directories and produce a dated launch checklist.

prompts.name: submit_to_saascity
prompts.title: Submit to SaaSCity
prompts.description: Draft a SaaSCity listing from the product site, confirm it with the human, then submit it.
